title: Machu Picchu, back to Cusco

weather.note: Cloud forest; highest shower chance of the trip; misty mornings often clear. Layers + rain shell.

glance: Early bus up the switchbacks for a guided tour of one of the Seven Wonders of the World, then train & drive back to Cusco.
logistics: also water, bug spray, rain layer

travel.detail: Aguas Calientes → Machu Picchu → train & drive back to Cusco
notes: Bring your passport — checked at the gate

reservations.name: Machu Picchu
reservations.address: Machu Picchu Historic Sanctuary, Cusco Region, Peru
reservations.note: Guided tour of the citadel — bring your passport, it's checked at the gate. The site opens after sunrise, and once the guided tour ends you have to exit.

picks.name: Cicciolina
picks.note: Long-loved creative Andean-Mediterranean cooking; a great celebratory dinner.

picks.name: Museo del Pisco
picks.note: Pisco bar with tastings & live music; a fun, low-key night.

notes: Site opens after sunrise (no sunrise visit); once the guided tour ends you must exit.
Wayna Picchu needs a separate permit booked months ahead — Intrepid leaders can't help arrange it, so sort it yourself early if you want the climb.
